┌─ Help: The mouse and the sidebar ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ The mouse                                                                                                                                │
│   Option-click ground walk there; the server plans the route, inside this zone (a plain click never moves you)                           │
│   Option-click mob  walk up to it, following it, and start attacking (Esc cancels)                                                       │
│   Option-click person, loot walk up and talk, or pick it up                                                                              │
│   Option-click marker walk to it (a scout point, a world event's mark)                                                                   │
│   Click mob, person select it and open its card (a click one cell off counts); click again (or F to attack, G to talk) to act            │
│   Click loot        pick up everything within reach; farther away it says how far                                                        │
│   W                 walk to the selected target, or to the last spot clicked: for a terminal that sends no Option-click                  │
│   Hover             its name beside the pointer: a mob, person, door, marker, or you                                                     │
│   Alt, Ctrl+A       name everything on the map (Ctrl+A if your terminal sends no Alt with the mouse)                                     │
│   Wheel, + -        zoom the map (the wheel over the Events, Chat or Party panel scrolls it back instead)                                │
│   Right-click, Esc  let go of the selection                                                                                              │
│                                                                                                                                          │
│   A plain click never moves you and a first click never attacks. Option (Alt) is the walking click: it is the same in the terminal and   │
│   in the browser. If your terminal keeps Option-click for itself, click, then press W. M opens the large map: Option-click a spot to     │
│   walk there, or move the cursor with the arrows and press Enter. Shift+click is never used: terminals keep it for selecting text. Every │
│   mouse action has a key; the game is fully playable without a mouse. docs/browser.md lists which terminals send Option-click.           │
│                                                                                                                                          │
│ The character sidebar                                                                                                                    │
│   C                 the next tab (in a narrow window, holds the sidebar open as a drawer; C or Esc puts it away)                         │
│   PgUp, PgDn        scroll (the wheel does too); click a tab to pick it                                                                  │
│   J                 at a vendor: sell all your junk (no gear slot, wanted by no contract of yours)                                       │
│   A                 at a vendor: sell the whole stack under the cursor                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                          │
│   Beside a trader, a trainer, the bank, a contract board or a conversation sits your character: Gear (what you wear), Bags (what you     │
│   carry, stacked, "Wolf Pelt ×2") and Stats (health, armour, accuracy, what your swing does now, and what gear adds to each attribute).  │
│   Every item says how it compares with what you wear in its slot: ▲ better, ▼ worse, = about the same, x you cannot use it (the card     │
│   says why). What you cannot afford is greyed out with how many crowns you are short.                                                    │
│                                                                                                                                          │
